title: PAUL_SFT_Example
description: Schema for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) training examples in PAUL Open Model Phase 3.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SFT training example.

track.description: Behavioral adaptation track or preservation category.

domain.description: Subject domain (e.g. physics, chemistry, biology, mathematics, education).

subdomain.description: Specific topic or conceptual area (e.g. kinematics, thermodynamics, genetics).

language.description: ISO-639-1 language code (e.g. en, hi, bn, ta, te, mr, gu, kn, ml, pa, or translation pair like en-to-hi).

messages.description: Chronological list of conversation turns in chat format.

target_grade.description: Target educational tier (e.g. primary, middle_school, high_school, undergraduate, teacher).

misconception_tag.description: Tag identifying the specific misconception being addressed (for Socratic track).

human_verified.description: Whether this example has received human expert sign-off.

benchmark_leakage_checked.description: Whether this example has passed the automated benchmark leakage check.

review_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of human review.

approved.description: Final approval boolean for training inclusion.
